efficiency.note: a candidate must be predicted to save at least 15% of prompt tokens

capability.note: online on the search set, a deployed candidate may lose at most one task against the incumbent; the judge cannot settle capability and does not pretend to

budget.note: measured runs per round, search plus held-out

revision.reason: version 1 named a coverage field that no code read, so the gate could decide on a predicted saving while the judge had replayed no step of the candidate at all
revision.evidence: rounds 2 and 3 deployed candidates with decision_replayable 0.0: their prompt divergence meant zero covered steps, and the saving was an extrapolation from the token model, not a replay
